# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster can check one object or place (up to a 5' radius) and tell if it is an
illusion or has an illusion on it.
@@ 2
Detects all invisible objects or beings in the area of effect. Caster can
concentrate on a different 5' radius each round. All attacks against something
so detected are modified by -50. See Section 15.5 (p. 96) for rules on
invisibility.
@@ 3
For the purposes of mental or magical detections, target appears to be of any
race the caster chooses.
@@ 4
As Misfeel Kind, except target’s level may be misrepresented by 1 level (up or
down).
@@ 5
Creates a false presence (for the purposes of magical detections) in the area
of effect.
@@ 6
As Misfeel Kind, except target’s profession may be misrepresented.
@@ 7
As Misfeel Power I, except target’s level may be misrepresented by up to 3
levels (up or down).
@@ 9
As Misfeel Power I, except an object’s power emanations may be reduced, so
that a minor item’s power is undetectable and major items seem like minor
items (for spells such as Detect Essence, Detect Power, Detect Channeling,
etc.).
@@ 10
As Misfeel Power I, except target’s level may be misrepresented by up to 5
levels (up or down).
@@ 11
One illusion within the area of effect ceases to exist (for the caster only).
@@ 12
As Detect Illusion, except caster can concentrate on one object or place per
round.
@@ 13
As Misfeel Power I, except target’s level can be misrepresented by up to 10
levels (up or down).
@@ 14
As Disillusion I, except up to three illusions within the area of effect cease
to exist.
@@ 15
Applies all the lower level Misfeels to a target at once (only one Misfeel
Power can be applied).
@@ 16
As Misfeel Kind, except target appears to have no presence.
@@ 17
As Disillusion I, except up to five illusions within the area of effect cease
to exist.
@@ 18
As Unpresence I, except will affect up to three targets.
@@ 19
As Disillusion I, except all illusions within the area of effect cease to
exist.
@@ 20
As Unpresence I, except affects up to five targets.
@@ 25
As Misfeel, except for duration.
@@ 30
As Unpresence, except up to 20 targets may be affected.
@@ 50
As Misfeel, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected.
